quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Announces ZENBEXUS (iberdomide) in (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive topline progression-free survival results from the Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM study (800 patients, multiple myeloma as early as first relapse): ZENBEXUS (iberdomide) with daratumumab and dexamethasone (ZDd) achieved median PFS of 42 months versus 20 months for daratumumab, bortezomib and dexamethasone (DVd) [HR 0.49, p<0.000001], a 51% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death, at a median follow-up of 23 months, meeting the second dual-primary endpoint; safety was consistent with previously reported findings. The data will be presented at the 68th ASH Annual Meeting.
quarterly_data.figure: median PFS 42 months vs 20 months; HR 0.49; 51% risk reduction
